name: goodvibes-app
description: GoodVibes desktop app: the unified GUI for the GoodVibes ecosystem (tui + agent feature set) on Bun + Electrobun.

scripts.dev: bun run build && bun run launch
scripts.generate: bun run generate:routes && bun run generate:presentation && bun run generate:config-schema && bun run generate:feature-settings && bun run generate:device-capabilities
scripts.generate:check: bun scripts/generate-operator-routes.ts --check && bun scripts/generate-presentation-tokens.ts --check && bun scripts/generate-config-schema.ts --check && bun scripts/generate-feature-settings.ts --check && bun scripts/generate-device-capabilities.ts --check
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run check:boundaries && bun run generate:check && bun test
